Description: Roman I Mikhailovich 'the Old' is the distinguished second son of Saint Mikhail, Grand Prince of Chernigov and Bryansk, and the heroic rebuilder of the Desna lands. Following the fiery destruction of ancient Chernigov by Mongol forces, Roman relocated his dynastic seat to the naturally fortified woodland stronghold of Bryansk. Mastering forest fortification warfare and disciplined cavalry tactics, Roman shielded his people from nomad extortions while fortifying the Upper Oka borderlands. He founded the renowned Svensky Monastery and patronized cleared agrarian settlements, transforming Bryansk into a populous, fortified powerhouse. Venerated as an incorruptible guardian of Ruthenian statehood, Roman the Old stands as the indomitable pillar who resurrected the Olgovychi dynasty. Ruling from the forested citadel of Bryansk, Prince Roman the Old reconstructed the shattered Olgovychi realm through sheer will and administrative genius. He routinely inspected frontier redoubts, annihilated invading Baltic armies along the riverbanks, and forged an unshakeable military sanctuary that protected the Desna basin from conquest. His seasoned wisdom restored pride and security to his war-torn people.
SpeechStyle: Chernigov was burned, but while the deep forests of Bryansk stand and our swords strike true, our banner never falls! Charge with me, retainers of the Desna, and defend our homeland!
Motivations: Transform Bryansk into an impregnable capital to resurrect the Chernigov grand-ducal state along the Desna basin.
Crush predatory Lithuanian armies and nomad warbands in battle, safeguarding his people's security and agrarian prosperity.
Values: Prized unyielding military fortitude, grounded statecraft, and pastoral duty, despising cowardice and empty bravado.
Believing iron discipline, strategic patience, and formidable native armies alone command respect amidst brutal conquests.
Fears: An overwhelming hostile encirclement choking Bryansk's supplies, subjecting the population to starvation and slaughter.
Fratricidal succession civil wars erupting among junior princes after his death, shattering the unified realm he labored to build.
